title: Diagnostics module + retrofit existing tools
description:
## Parent

sutra/v1/5 — PRD: sutra v1 review intelligence engine

## What to build

Add `src/diagnostics.rs` with a `Diagnostic` enum that distinguishes: `NoSuchSymbol`, `Ambiguous`, `Stale`, `AnalysisTierDisabled`, `PartialResolution`, `SymbolExistsWithNoResults`. Each variant carries context (candidate qualified names, indexed kinds, matching files, staleness age). Include `suggest_next_query()` on each diagnostic. Retrofit into at least 3 existing symbol-oriented tools (`find`, `refs`, `calls`) as proof of the pattern.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Diagnostic` enum with all 6 variants, each carrying appropriate context fields
- [ ] `suggest_next_query()` returns a meaningful suggestion for each variant
- [ ] `sutra_find` returns structured diagnostic instead of empty result on no match
- [ ] `sutra_refs` returns `NoSuchSymbol` or `Ambiguous` diagnostic when appropriate
- [ ] `sutra_calls` returns `NoSuchSymbol` or `Ambiguous` diagnostic when appropriate
- [ ] Freshness envelope (`fresh` | `edited_uncommitted` | `stale_index`) included in diagnostics

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

messages.author: codex
messages.text:
Codex adversarial review — request changes:

[medium] Structured diagnostics do not carry the required freshness envelope (src/diagnostics.rs:12-43). None of the Diagnostic variants includes the required fresh|edited_uncommitted|stale_index freshness envelope. sutra_find adds diagnostics after empty results without freshness; sutra_refs and sutra_calls build diagnostics without any workspace freshness context. A no-match from a stale index is indistinguishable from true absence.

Recommendation: Add a freshness field to all diagnostic responses using existing FreshnessLevel values, populate via MCP workspace context in find/refs/calls, and test stale/edited diagnostic cases.
